rounds.fact: 2007 was the year Netflix quietly added streaming as a bonus feature for DVD subscribers. Almost nobody noticed at the time that it would eventually replace the DVDs entirely.
Epinions paid ordinary users for writing product reviews, an early attempt to build trust in user opinions before that became a standard feature on almost every shopping site.
Travelocity launched in 1996 and was one of the first travel sites to let people book flights directly online, years before that became the default way to travel-plan.
Lycos was briefly the most-visited website on the internet in 1999, its search engine and portal combo making it a serious early rival to Yahoo.
Tripod was a major free website-builder alongside GeoCities and Angelfire, and was eventually bought by Lycos as part of its portal strategy in the late 90s.
